decisions.reason: The system layout and CAD used for build integration must represent the newly specified downward spout geometry.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: To preserve the better drink consistency, I’d like the spouts to direct the pour downward as shown in the rendering rather than use a flat slope.

value_updates.spout_orientation_constraint: Spouts direct the pour downward as shown in the rendering rather than using a flat slope.
